name: utm-guard
description: Build UTM-tagged URLs from a controlled vocabulary that refuses unknown values, and lint your files for links that forgot their tags. Keeps your analytics clean at the source.

scripts.demo:build: node index.js build /guides/arc-registration --source linkedin --medium social --campaign launch --vocab examples/utm.vocab.example.json
scripts.demo:refuse: node index.js build /guides/arc-registration --source LinkedIn --medium social --vocab examples/utm.vocab.example.json

author: Howard Park
